EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (GENERAL) (AMENDMENT) REGULATONS 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 105 of

the Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following

regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security

(General) (Amendment) Regulations 2016.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 8 March 2016.

Substitution of regulation 79

2. The Employees' Social Security (General) Regulations 1971 [P.U. (A) 99/1971],

which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these Regulations, are amended

by substituting for regulation 79 the following regulation:

"Constitution

of Medical

Board.

79. (1) For the purposes of the Act, a Medical Board

shall consist of the following members:

(a) the Hospital Director or his

representative, as Chairman; and

(b) two members from amongst the

Medical Specialists or Medical Officers.

(2) The Medical Board shall be constituted at the

social security area and location as specified in Schedule IV.".

New regulations 79A, 79B and 79C

3. The principal Regulations are amended by inserting after regulation 79 the

following regulations:

"Constitution of

Special Medical

Board.

79A. (1) For the purposes of the Act, a Special

Medical Board shall consist of the following members:

(a) the Hospital Director or his

representative, as Chairman; and

(b) two Medical Specialists in the relevant

medical field.

(2) The Special Medical Board shall be constituted

at the social security area and location as specified in

Schedule V.

Constitution of

Appellate

Medical Board

for Peninsular

Malaysia.

79B. (1) For the purposes of the Act, an Appellate

Medical Board for Peninsular Malaysia shall consist of the

following members:

(a) the Director General of Health or his

representative, as Chairman; and

(b) two Consultant Specialists in the relevant

medical field.

(2) The Appellate Medical Board for Peninsular

Malaysia shall be constituted at the social security area and

location as specified in Schedule VI.

Constitution of

Appellate

Medical Board

for Sabah and

Sarawak.

79C. (1) For the purposes of the Act, an Appellate Medical

Board for Sabah and Sarawak shall consist of the following

members:

(a) the State Director of Health or his

representative, as Chairman; and

(b) two Consultant Specialists in the

relevant medical field.

(2) The Appellate Medical Board for Sabah and

Sarawak shall be constituted at the social security area and

location as specified in Schedule VII.".
